title: POST /v1/demos: an account token asks for a demo; idempotent, capped at live demos per account, model budget, guarded photo fetch, nothing written on refusal
steps: S1: Drive /v1/demos through its routes on a scratch Postgres (account token faked with part A's signature, network and object store faked).
S2: Validate website-opportunities/demo-request/v1 in the open package.
expect: S1: same key + body → same demo, other body → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; concurrent and after-crash retries make one demo.
S1: the 21st live demo → 409 DEMO_LIMIT_REACHED {live:20, limit:20}; deleting one makes room; at the cap only one of concurrent requests wins.
S1: over the model budget → 503 SPONSOR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED before accepting; an own AI account reserves 0 cents.
S1: bad schema / oversize / private or redirected-private photo URL → 4xx with no row and no stored object; a seat key → 403; accountId/siteKey/ownSite in the body refused by field.
S1: cancel before the build frees the slot, after keeps it; ready only with QA passed; polling never moves the retention dates.
S2: unknown fields (verified, provenance, objectKey, accountId) are refused by path.
fence: The door's validation, idempotency, live cap, budget and SSRF guard; the build itself is the existing demo runner's

tests: a demo request becomes the account
a retry with the same key and body
concurrent sends of one key make one demo
a send that died before its commit
at 19 live demos, concurrent new requests
cancel before the site frees the slot
bad schema, an oversize body, a private photo URL
a body naming the account, a site or ownSite
retention dates come from the WO demo clock
the server answers /v1/demos on the api host only
a field the contract does not name is refused by its path
